case_name: Smt. Sipra Nath vs Sri Subhra Narayan Nath
facts_of_case: The respondent-husband, a cancer patient, contracted remarriage despite knowing the consequences of violating Section 15 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The wife filed an application for recall of an order granting injunction against the husband's remarriage.

legal_principles.principle: A court's hands are tied if a second marriage has already been contracted.
legal_principles.held: the court's hands are tied inasmuch as on the date when the injunction order was passed, a second marriage had already been contracted by the respondent, thereby rendering the order of injunction infructuous ab initio.

legal_principles.principle: A stay order cannot be passed after a divorce decree has been implemented.
legal_principles.held: there is no scope of passing any stay order, as the impugned divorce decree has already been implemented by the respondent by contracting a remarriage on the premise that the previous marriage with the appellant was severed.

outcome.final_order: The court condoned the delay in filing the recall application and recalled the earlier order restraining the respondent-husband from contracting remarriage.

use_for_drafting: condoning delay in filing an application
